top_signals.title: Oil drops more than 3% as U.S. shifts to economic pressure on Iran, easing fears of renewed war
top_signals.summary: Investors shrugged off the latest developments in the U.S.-Iran war.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: CNBC Daily Open: The U.S. is flexing its economic power — drawing retaliation
top_signals.summary: Washington has launched an economic offensive against Iran and Canada — the two countries one would normally not lump together.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Short Squeeze in US Long Bonds Shows ‘Bessent Put’ at Work
top_signals.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s surprise plan to tamp down US borrowing costs by expanding bond buybacks may have sparked fierce debate about its ultimate effectiveness, but key market metrics and positioning show that it’s having an impact.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
